calibration_selection: Minimum development log score averaged equally over both cancers and all three original designs; failed-capacity cells retained separately
primary_B: MORE_CTMC minus BRIDGE_CTMC hidden log score; all6cells, fixed638 assays. Same-model allocation comparison, not superiority claim over every estimator.
primary_C: BASE_CTMC versus frozen paid AUDIT calibration: Brier+log score and 5binECE. Compare to MORE_CTMC and BRIDGE_CTMC, direct cell and marginal estimators.
secondary_C: Finite evaluation-reference expected calibration under known scorer-only perturbation; estimator never sees probabilities or weights.
bootstrap: 200 patient-role resamples per cancer/design; refit CTMC and pooled for all arms and frozen calibrators. Seeds do not multiply patient sample size.
score_6_5: Both cancers show average proper-score improvement over all three designs, supporting a scoped paid-information claim; report every failing cell and bootstrap uncertainty. Original stronger algorithm/oldmask claim keeps its old score.
score_8: Broad agreement across all six cells, meaningful paired uncertainty support and strong-baseline evidence; no claims of natural-parameter recovery.
bugfix_before_confirm_results: Shuffled-label control uses big-endian state code (3-h), not h. First launch failed with negative bincount; no completed scientific evaluation result. Original failure log retained.
